description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as measured by MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10) against the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 0 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “# of queries used during inference (S)”, is linearly scaled with tick marks at integer intervals (0, 2, 4, 6, 8). The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, is also linearly scaled from approximately 33.5 to 36.5, with major tick marks every 0.5 units. Six distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o gold” (black solid line) starts at ~34.8 and remains nearly flat; “DPR w/ top-1” (yellow solid line with circle markers) begins at ~33.5 and rises steadily to ~36.0; “DPR w/ bottom-1” (green solid line with circle markers) starts at ~34.8, dips slightly, then climbs sharply to ~36.5; “DPR w/ random” (purple dashed line with circle markers) begins at ~35.0 and increases gradually to ~35.8; “DPR w/ curriculum” (blue solid line with circle markers) starts at ~35.0 and rises steadily to ~36.0; and “DPR w/ gold” (red solid line with circle markers) begins at ~35.0 and increases to ~36.5. All lines show non-decreasing trends, with “DPR w/ bottom-1” and “DPR w/ gold” achieving the highest final MRR@10 values.
